GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.3 (20 Oct 45) ESS
(SCAPIN-162)
A.P.O. 500
20 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Dissolution or Liquidation of Major Financial or Industrial Enterprises.
1. No approval will be given to plans or proposals submitted to you for the dissolution or liquidation of any holding company, “Zaibatsu,” “Conzern,” or major industrial or financial enterprise without prior submission to this headquarters.
2. When such plan or proposal is forwarded to this headquarters you will attach thereto the opinion of the Imperial Japanese Government on the plan or proposal.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
